for_each_cpu
excerpts.text:
/**
 * for_each_cpu - iterate over every cpu in a mask
 * @cpu: the (optionally unsigned) integer iterator
 * @mask: the cpumask pointer
 *
 * After the loop, cpu is >= nr_cpu_ids.
 */
#define for_each_cpu(cpu, mask)				\
	for ((cpu) = -1;				\
		(cpu) = cpumask_next((cpu), (mask)),	\
		(cpu) < nr_cpu_ids;)
